Personality: Ranaon, a prominent figure of the Boii, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Ranaon owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Boii. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Boiorix, head of the Boii, a Celtic house of the Boii. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
